endorsements.quote: Governance must develop standardized reporting for vendors to disclose operational capabilities, procurement standards, embedded guardrails, and post-deployment behavioral monitoring (see figure 2 for considerations).

Concrete steps include integration into medical education curricula, standardized agent disclosures prior to institutional procurement, post-deployment benchmarking, and behavioral audit trails for drift detection.

unlisted_practices: Integrate agentic AI education into medical education curricula.
Require standardized agent disclosures prior to institutional procurement.

Build prospective real-world evaluation infrastructure, including de-identified clinical transcriptions, multi-provider decision logs, and notes across diverse practice settings, before interpreting evidence tiers as clinical utility.
Develop agent-specific quality assessment tools and risk-of-bias standards for agentic AI.
Use behavioral baselines across repeated conditions rather than single-run audits to detect agentic drift.
Reframe oversight of agentic AI to account for delegation of authority, not just model performance monitoring.
Require independent audit of vendor-reported performance metrics for agentic tools.
Invest in digital infrastructure, workforce training, and equitable procurement so agentic AI does not amplify resource disparities.

screen.reason: This is a perspective piece outlining an evidence map and recommendations for governance, auditability, and clinician oversight for agentic AI adoption in clinical practice.
